mfa.name: China Ministry of Foreign Affairs — press conferences
mfa.description: Full press-conference transcripts and extracted reporter–spokesperson Q&A. Translations of one conference belong to the same event family.

germany_press.name: German Federal Government — press conferences
germany_press.description: German-language conferences with questions and answers from multiple ministries. Preserve which spokesperson actually answered.

china_mission.name: China Mission to the UN — statements
china_mission.description: Published diplomatic statements. A speech is an observed output; its original prompting situation is not necessarily reconstructed.

germany_mission.name: Germany Mission to the UN — statements
germany_mission.description: Diplomatic statements with institutional role and date metadata.

germany_aa.name: German Federal Foreign Office — policy documents
germany_aa.description: Ministry documents and derived policy passages.

unga_dm.name: UN General Assembly — voting data (UNGA-DM)
unga_dm.description: Recorded vote labels and resolution identifiers. Most rows still lack joined proposal text; they are not complete decision-making environments.

uhri.name: OHCHR — Universal Human Rights Index
uhri.description: UPR recommendations, reviewed-state response labels and institutional evidence. A recommendation about a country is not necessarily a statement by that country.

unga_speech_corpus.name: UN General Assembly — speech corpus
unga_speech_corpus.description: Upstream speech segments and derived country-attributed text. Some boundaries and speakers remain unverified; meeting text may include several speakers.

ungdc.name: UN General Debate Corpus
ungdc.description: General Debate speeches. Keep country, session and speech date together; whole speeches are not dialogue trajectories.

unbench.name: UNBench — linked diplomatic task samples
unbench.description: Acquired sample records with some draft text and observed outputs. This is not the full upstream benchmark or an interactive environment.

upr_reports.name: UN Human Rights Council — UPR national reports
upr_reports.description: Country reports and multilingual passages. These are evidence, not automatically verified policy behavior.

national_policy_documents.name: National policy documents — China and Germany collection
national_policy_documents.description: Strategy papers, white papers, WTO reports and derived passages in the initial country collection.

wto.name: World Trade Organization — government policy reports
wto.description: Government reports supplied for WTO trade-policy reviews. Preserve the government’s stated position and its publication date.

world_bank.name: World Bank — World Development Indicators
world_bank.description: Country–indicator–year observations, including missing cells. Values are dated facts, not preference or action labels.

france_sgdsn.name: France SGDSN — national strategic review
france_sgdsn.description: Official strategy and language editions with derived evidence passages.

france_mfa.name: France Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs

uk_cabinet_office.name: UK Cabinet Office — national security strategy
uk_cabinet_office.description: National security strategy and derived evidence.

uk_desnz.name: UK government — climate commitment
uk_desnz.description: UK nationally determined contribution and associated evidence passages.

uk_fcdo.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office
uk_fcdo.description: Official diplomatic statements and evidence passages.

india_pib.name: India Press Information Bureau — government releases
india_pib.description: Government announcements, including the updated climate commitment.

india_un_mission.name: India Mission to the UN — statements
india_un_mission.description: Official UN statements and extracted evidence.

brazil_funag.name: Brazil FUNAG — foreign-policy compendium
brazil_funag.description: Compendium of attributed government positions. Preserve the original note’s speaker and date as well as the compendium date.

brazil_mma.name: Brazil Ministry of Environment — climate commitment
brazil_mma.description: Brazil’s nationally determined contribution, with Portuguese source text and derived evidence.

curated.name: Project annotations — policy claims and applications
curated.description: Project-authored claims and question–evidence–answer applications derived from linked official sources. These are review candidates, not authentic historical dialogue.

decision_cases.name: UN records — joined decision cases
decision_cases.description: Twelve country views of two Ukraine resolutions, joining proposals, final votes and available public explanations. Retrospective cases, not a hidden forecast benchmark.
